title: Audit: Find localStorage keys that leak between users
description: Use critique-waves technique to audit localStorage/sessionStorage usage for user data leaks.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Create instructions.md with FORBIDDEN/REQUIRED patterns for localStorage
Create tracker.md with goal of 6 consecutive passes
Run waves of 3 parallel agents checking: (1) src/ localStorage, (2) src/ sessionStorage, (3) logout handlers
Continue until 6 consecutive passes or issues found

notes: CODE REVIEW ONLY - NO BROWSER. Use critique-waves technique: 3 agents max parallel, write to separate MD files, track consecutive passes. FORBIDDEN: localStorage keys without user scoping. REQUIRED: logout clears user-specific data. Known keys: songscript_visitor_id, songscript_welcome_shown.
